028/**
029 * The unique entry point to allow you to access most features of QuickShop
030 */
031public interface QuickShopAPI {
032
033  static QuickShopAPI getInstance() {
034
035    final RegisteredServiceProvider<QuickShopProvider> provider = Bukkit.getServicesManager().getRegistration(QuickShopProvider.class);
036    if(provider == null) {
037      throw new IllegalStateException("QuickShop hadn't loaded at this moment.");
038    }
039    return provider.getProvider().getApiInstance();
040  }
041
042  static Plugin getPluginInstance() {
043
044    final RegisteredServiceProvider<QuickShopProvider> provider = Bukkit.getServicesManager().getRegistration(QuickShopProvider.class);
045    if(provider == null) {
046      throw new IllegalStateException("QuickShop hadn't loaded at this moment.");
047    }
048    return provider.getPlugin();
049  }
050
051  /**
052   * Retrieves the map of all registered hooks in the QuickShop system. Each hook
053   * is identified by its unique string identifier and provides custom integration
054   * capabilities for plugins or addons.
055   *
056   * @return a map containing hook identifiers as keys and their corresponding Hook
057   *         instances as values. The map will be empty if no hooks are registered.
058   */
059  Map<String, Hook> hooks();
060
061  /**
062   * Iterates through all registered hooks in the QuickShop system and enables them
063   * if they meet the requirements for activation. The hooks are retrieved from the
064   * internal map of registered hooks, where each hook is identified by a unique string key.
065   *
066   * This method ensures that hooks capable of being enabled are activated, allowing
067   * for custom integrations or behaviors added by plugins or addons to become functional.
068   *
069   * The activation of individual hooks depends on their internal logic, as determined
070   * by the {@code canEnable()} method of each hook. If a hook is eligible, its {@code enable()}
071   * method is invoked to update its state.
072   *
073   * Note: This method operates on all hooks currently available in the system through
074   * the {@code hooks()} method and does not handle any hooks added or removed after its invocation.
075   */
076  default void loadHooks() {
077
078    for(final Hook hook : hooks().values()) {
079
080      if(hook.canEnable()) {
081        hook.enable();
082      }
083    }
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Adds a new hook to the QuickShop system. The hook is identified by its unique identifier
088   * and is stored in the hooks map. This allows plugins or addons to integrate with
089   * QuickShop by providing custom behavior through hooks.
090   *
091   * @param hook the hook to be added, must not be null. The identifier of the hook must be unique.
092   */
093  default void addHook(final Hook hook) {
094
095    hooks().put(hook.identifier().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), hook);
096  }
097
098  /**
099   * Removes a hook from the QuickShop system using its unique identifier. The hook is removed
100   * from the internal hooks map, which is used to manage integrations or custom behaviors added
101   * to QuickShop by plugins or addons.
102   *
103   * @param identifier the unique identifier of the hook to be removed, must not be null.
104   */
105  default void removeHook(final String identifier) {
106
107    hooks().remove(identifier.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Getting command manager that allow addon direct access QuickShop sub-command system
112   *
113   * @return The command manager
114   */
115  CommandManager getCommandManager();
116
117  /**
118   * Getting the helper to directly access the database
119   *
120   * @return The database helper
121   */
122  DatabaseHelper getDatabaseHelper();
123
124  /**
125   * Getting this server game version
126   *
127   * @return Game version
128   */
129  GameVersion getGameVersion();
130
131  /**
132   * Gets registry of InventoryWrappers
133   *
134   * @return registry
135   */
136  @NotNull
137  InventoryWrapperRegistry getInventoryWrapperRegistry();
138
139  /**
140   * Getting current using ItemMatcher impl
141   *
142   * @return The item matcher
143   */
144  ItemMatcher getItemMatcher();
145
146  /**
147   * Retrieves the EconomyManager instance that manages all economies associated with their unique
148   * identifiers.
149   *
150   * @return The EconomyManager instance.
151   */
152  EconomyManager getEconomyManager();
153
154  /**
155   * Retrieves the TagManager associated with the QuickShop system. The TagManager
156   * is responsible for handling operations related to managing tags, which may
157   * include inventory item metadata and custom item tags used by the system.
158   *
159   * @return The TagManager instance that provides functionality for tag-related
160   *         operations within the QuickShop system.
161   */
162  TagManager tagManager();
163
164  /**
165   * Getting the control panel manager
166   *
167   * @return Shop control panel manager
168   */
169  ShopControlPanelManager getShopControlPanelManager();
170
171  /**
172   * Retrieves the InteractionManager associated with this QuickShopProvider.
173   *
174   * @return The InteractionManager that manages InteractionBehaviors and InteractionTypes.
175   */
176  InteractionManager getInteractionManager();
177
178  /**
179   * Getting Shop Manager which managing most of shops
180   *
181   * @return Shop manager
182   */
183  ShopManager getShopManager();
184
185  /**
186   * Retrieves the instance of the DisplayManager responsible for managing display functionalities.
187   *
188   * @return The DisplayManager instance, which handles operations related to displays for various types of entities.
189   */
190  @Nullable
191  DisplayManager<?> getDisplayManager();
192
193  /**
194   * Getting text manager that allow addon to create a user language locale based message
195   *
196   * @return The text maanger
197   */
198  TextManager getTextManager();
199
200  /**
201   * Getting QuickShop current stacking item support status
202   *
203   * @return Stacking Item support enabled
204   */
205  boolean isAllowStack();
206
207  /**
208   * Getting QuickShop current display item support status
209   *
210   * @return Display item enabled
211   */
212  boolean isDisplayEnabled();
213
214  RankLimiter getRankLimiter();
215
216  PlayerFinder getPlayerFinder();
217
218  /**
219   * Check if fee required for changing shop price
220   *
221   * @return requires fee
222   */
223  boolean isPriceChangeRequiresFee();
224
225  /**
226   * Logs a event into logs database / file
227   *
228   * @param eventObject event object, must can be serialized by Gson.
229   */
230  void logEvent(@NotNull Object eventObject);
231
232  /**
233   * Register a localized translation key mapping to another key or fixed string
234   *
235   * @param translationKey the key to
236   * @param key            the key to map to or a fixed string
237   */
238  void registerLocalizedTranslationKeyMapping(@NotNull String translationKey, @NotNull String key);
239
240  Semver getSemVersion();
241
242  ShopItemBlackList getShopItemBlackList();
243
244  RegistryManager getRegistry();
245}
